# Policy: maximize discovery by allowing search, answer-engine, user-agent,
# and model crawlers to read public pages so Jiphyeonjeon can be found,
# summarized, and cited. Private, tokenized, and per-user paths stay
# disallowed for everyone.
# Evidence basis: OpenAI separates OAI-SearchBot (Search/automatic crawl),
# GPTBot (foundation-model training), and ChatGPT-User (user-initiated fetches);
# Anthropic separates Claude-SearchBot/Claude-User (visibility for search/user
# queries) from ClaudeBot (model-development training); Google AI features use
# ordinary indexed, crawlable pages and require no special AI markup.
# Note: /api/ is broadly blocked except for public blog resources: images
# (/api/blog/thumbnail/, /api/blog/figures/) and the read-only post/tag API
# (/api/blog/posts, /api/blog/tags). The post API must stay crawlable or
# Google's renderer blocks the SPA's XHR, the client marks the page noindex,
# and every post becomes un-indexable despite perfect SSR HTML.
# Note: /paper-viewer is deliberately NOT disallowed. Blog post bodies link to
# it ~229 times (one per cited reference, each with a distinct query string).
# Disallowing it meant crawlers discovered every one of those URLs but were
# blocked from fetching them, so they never saw the route's own
# `noindex,follow` (PaperViewerRoute.tsx) — the exact recipe for "Indexed,
# though blocked by robots.txt". Letting the fetch through lets the noindex do
# its job, and `follow` returns the link equity to the cited posts.

# Default policy for all crawlers: public pages allowed, private paths blocked.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /blog
Allow: /blog/
Allow: /api/blog/thumbnail/
Allow: /api/blog/figures/
Allow: /api/blog/posts
Allow: /api/blog/tags
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /mypage
Disallow: /mypage/
Disallow: /share/*
Disallow: /share/curriculum/*
Disallow: /api/admin*
Disallow: /api/me*
Disallow: /api/bookmarks*
Disallow: /api/shared/*
Disallow: /api/shared/curriculum/*
Disallow: /api/auth*
Disallow: /api/recommendations*
Disallow: /api/analytics*
Disallow: /api/private*
Disallow: /api/user*

# AI search, answer, user, and model crawlers: allowed on public pages to
# maximize discovery and citation. Private paths stay blocked exactly as above.
